description: Proposed creation of permeable hardstanding within the front garden to provide off-street parking, with surface water drainage retained within the property and a minimum 10% soft landscaping provided. Works include partial removal/alteration of the existing front boundary wall to form vehicle access, with remaining boundary treatment/landscaping retained where possible. A dropped kerb/vehicle crossover is proposed, subject to separate highways approval by the Council.
